description: Abstract class for managing Cassandra cluster connections, including session initialization, metrics reporting, and configuration handling within the Thingsboard project.

classes.name: AbstractCassandraCluster
classes.description: Abstract class providing Cassandra cluster connection management, including session setup, metrics, and configuration.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the cluster with the specified keyspace and prepares the session builder.

methods.name: getSession
methods.description: Returns the current GuavaSession, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getKeyspaceName
methods.description: Returns the name of the Cassandra keyspace.

methods.name: isInstall
methods.description: Checks if the environment profile is set to 'install'.

methods.name: initSession
methods.description: Sets up the Cassandra session with appropriate configuration, including metrics reporting.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the session and stops metrics reporting when the object is destroyed.

methods.name: getDefaultReadConsistencyLevel
methods.description: Returns the default read consistency level from driver options.

methods.name: getDefaultWriteConsistencyLevel
methods.description: Returns the default write consistency level from driver options.
